import pathlib,hashlib,json,os,sys
root=pathlib.Path('/work/stock-fw-stage-v1')
partial=root/'source-stock-firmware.tar.gz.partial'
expected='fc331d84ed585457b4183b08f799a49d9839d3114bf5ec2f281a725b87fe5f92'
hasher=hashlib.sha256();count=0
fd=os.open(partial,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as out:
 while block:=sys.stdin.buffer.read(1048576):
  count+=len(block)
  if count>15747897:raise ValueError('source archive too large')
  out.write(block);hasher.update(block)
 out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
if count!=15747897 or hasher.hexdigest()!=expected:raise ValueError('input copy mismatch')
final=root/'source-stock-firmware.tar.gz'
partial.rename(final)
record={'source':'owner private stock-firmware-20261123 archive','file':str(final),'size_bytes':count,'sha256':hasher.hexdigest(),'source_unchanged':True,'mode':oct(final.stat().st_mode & 0o777),'status':'verified_container_input_copy'}
(root/'source-copy.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record))
